analyzed_vuln.description: The root cause is type confusion in tag serialization: Type_ViewingConditions_Write blindly casts the tag payload pointer to cmsICCViewingConditions* and reads two cmsCIEXYZ structs plus a uint32, without validating that the underlying tag object actually has that layout/size. In this PoV, corrupted profile/tag state causes the writer for viewingConditions ('view') to be used on data that is not a cmsICCViewingConditions object (allocated as a smaller/different object, seen as 40-byte region from cmsPipelineAlloc). This leads to out-of-bounds reads when _cmsWriteXYZNumber accesses sc->SurroundXYZ/sc->IlluminantType (crash at _cmsWriteXYZNumber on XYZ->Z).
analyzed_vuln.conditions: Harness cms_profile_fuzzer opens attacker-controlled ICC bytes, reads tags (including cmsReadTag(cmsSigGamutTag)), then calls cmsSaveProfileToFile. During SaveTags, tag type is chosen and LocalTypeHandler.WritePtr is invoked for each tag. With malformed input that makes a tag be serialized via the viewing-conditions writer while TagPtrs[i] points to incompatible/smaller memory, Type_ViewingConditions_Write performs unchecked field reads past the allocation, triggering ASan heap-buffer-overflow during profile save.
